name: Edward H. Shpritz
concepts: Do You See What I See?
heroLine: Do you see what I see?
heroSub: Quiet pictures that ask you to look a little longer.
intro: Photographs from Chicago, the lakefront, and the wild places in between. Some are sharp and still. Some are soft and moving. Every one of them began with a question.
lessIsMore: The white frames and the soft frames are where less is more. Very little in the picture, and a great deal to feel. Step back, slow down, and let the quiet ones speak.

bio.heading: A few words from Ed
body: I am an optometrist by day, moved by nature, her beauty and her geometry.
Photography has been my joy since I was a boy, and now it is my passion. Capturing some of the beauty that nature paints on her palette is my honor to share with you.

edisms: Beauty within, shines outside. Beauty outside, only shines.
Do you see what I see?
A quiet picture is still saying something.
